subject: Capacity handoff: CloudFlux dedicated sizing and commitment plan
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@cloudflux.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@cloudflux.com
Date: 2027-05-22T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask for Q3 pilot -> Redwood

Hi Mateo,

Good chatting earlier — CloudFlux is targeting a small production pilot for our inference backplane starting July 1. We need a dedicated capacity proposal tied to our forecast so we can route this through procurement and get a PO out. Key asks: 

- Start date: 2027-07-01
- Expected steady-state: ~120 concurrent sessions, median seq len ~1024, 600k tokens/day (spiky bursts up to 2M tokens over 6 hours)
- Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for text generation routes
- Data isolation for pilot; standard SOC2 contract language is fine

I've attached our forecast (CloudFlux_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx). Would appreciate a short capacity proposal and an estimated monthly committed cost (plus burst pricing). Can you loop in your infra/finance folks?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Chen
Head of ML Platform, CloudFlux
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@cloudflux.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-22T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask for Q3 pilot -> Redwood

Thanks Emma — got the forecast and it's clear. Looping in Laura (sales ops) and Karthik (capacity planning) to shape a 3-option sizing & pricing pack. High-level plan I'll send later today:

Option A (Conservative reserve): 4x A100-class GPUs, dedicated pool, autoscale burst to 6x for peak windows. Expected monthly commit: $70k.
Option B (Balanced): 3x A100-class reserved with caching & optimized batching, burst to 5x. Expected monthly commit: $50k.
Option C (Pay-as-you-go + short reserve): No long reserve, configured for burst-first; estimated run-rate varies — good for a shorter pilot.

Questions for you (quick): 1) Do you need pinning to a specific region? 2) Any encryption/KMS constraints beyond standard SOC2?

I'll circulate an internal ask to confirm infra/finance inputs and will share a draft reserve quote by EOD.

- Mateo
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-22T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: CloudFlux (DEAL-8921) capacity sizing — please review

Team,

Emma sent the forecast (attached). Need quick alignment so we can present a committed quote to procurement:

Ask: review the three-option proposal below and flag build/risk/cost changes by 4pm PT today. We need infra signoff on lead time and burst feasibility, and finance to confirm discount tiers for a 12-month reserve.

Proposed options (first pass):
- Option A (4 GPUs reserved, burst to 6): target p95 latency < 350ms using prefix cache + kv warming. Monthly commit estimate: $70,000.
- Option B (3 GPUs reserved, burst to 5): leverage aggressive batching + 8GB quantized model to save 25% token cost. Monthly commit estimate: $50,000.
- Option C (no reserve): configure for burst-first with higher per-token rate; useful if procurement wants a short pilot.

Operational constraints:
- Region: us-west-2 preferred by the customer (Emma confirmed) — confirm node availability for July 1.
- Prewarming: model KV cache warm-up may require scheduled prewarm jobs for first 48 hours; factor ops time.
- SLA exceptions: customer asked for p95 < 350ms; we can commit to p95 < 400ms with fallback to a slightly cheaper model variant if needed.

Attachments: CFX_capacity_model_8921.xlsx (run-rate model), redwood_reserve_quote_DEAL-8921.pdf (draft).

Thanks — please reply inline with redlines.

- Mateo
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-22T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: CloudFlux (DEAL-8921) capacity sizing — please review

Quick notes after scanning the model:

- Recommend Option B as the baseline for the pilot (best balance of cost + performance).
- Increase burst headroom to +2 GPUs (so B becomes 3 reserved + burst to 7) given the customer's stated 6-hour burst window — avoids throttling risk.
- Finance (Monica) — can we accommodate standard 10% volume discount for a 12-month commit starting 7/1? If yes, adjust quote template.
- Karthik: confirm availability of nodes in us-west-2 for a July 1 start and estimate lead time for provisioning + prewarm (we'll need ops runbook).

If infra says we can't hit p95 < 350ms reliably, call that out in the customer-facing proposal with the fallback plan.

- Laura
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@cloudflux.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: CloudFlux pilot — updated sizing & mutual action plan (DEAL-8921)

Emma — thanks for the quick reply earlier. Per our internal review we've refined the options and included an explicit runbook / milestones to make procurement comfortable. Summary below (full quote attached):

Selected baseline (recommended): Option B-Plus
- Reserved: 3x A100-class GPUs in us-west-2
- Burst: up to 7 GPUs during peak windows (auto-scale, billed on usage)
- Optimizations: model quantization + batching, prefix caching to reduce token cost
- Commit term: 12 months starting 2027-07-01 (we've priced a 10% volume discount in the attachment)
- Estimated committed monthly: $45,000 (after discount). Burst usage billed on top per-token.

Mutual action plan / timeline:
- 5/23: Finalize sizing & quote (this email)
- 5/24: Contract/PO routing — we will provide a DocuSign link and SOW stub
- 5/26: Customer PO due (CloudFlux)
- 6/24: Go/no-go review for production ramp (internal + customer)
- 7/01: Start of reserved capacity (provision + prewarm in us-west-2)

Operational notes: prewarm jobs will run the night before start; we'll coordinate a 2-hour cutover window. Attachments: redwood_reserve_quote_DEAL-8921.pdf, CFX_capacity_model_8921.xlsx.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8921); DocuSign (https://docusign.com/envelopes/rc-8921).

Please reply here if that looks good and we'll open the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks —
Mateo
From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@cloudflux.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@cloudflux.com
Date: 2027-05-24T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudFlux pilot — updated sizing & mutual action plan (DEAL-8921)

Mateo — this looks good. We will route the quote through procurement today and send a PO by 5/26 as requested. A couple notes from contracts: we need standard SOC2 attestation and a one-off clause for data residency logs retention for 12 months; I'll attach the redlines if any.

On the timeline: PO by 5/26 is realistic from our side. Please confirm you can provision and complete prewarm by 7/1 assuming PO is signed on 5/26.

Once we get the DocuSign I will countersign.

Emma
Head of ML Platform, CloudFlux
